This is a fresh petition, filed by the petitioners, under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, seeking to quash the FIR No. 0507/2023 dated 14.08.2023 for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 186,0 registered at Police Station Punjabi Bagh, Delhi and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present petition and submits that he shall raise the arguments, based on the grounds and submissions as taken in the present petition, before the learned Trial Court at the time of This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re
-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/07/2025 at 22:12:50 addressing arguments on Charge.
3. Permission, as prayed for, is granted.
4.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
